05 / YOUR QUESTIONS

Let's make
things clear.

Still have a question?
Let's talk

01How do we get started?

With a short introduction and a conversation about your plans. We then put together a detailed brief: who will use the space, which daily habits matter, and what budget and timeline you have in mind.

02Can we work together remotely?

Yes. Conversations, presentations and approvals can all happen online. Accurate measurements, photographs and a video of the property will be needed. Any site visits are agreed separately.

03What is included in the design fee?

The scope depends on the service you choose. Each service has a detailed list of deliverables. Finishes, furniture, construction work and purchases are separate from the design fee.

04What if I don't know which style I like?

That is a perfectly good place to start. We explore your habits, favourite places and the feelings you want at home. Visual references help us gradually find the right language for your interior.

05Can the design change along the way?

Yes. Review stages and revision rounds are agreed before work begins. If the brief or floor area changes, we first agree on any effect on the timeline and fee.

EVERY SPACE HAS A STORY
